notes_for_editor: Identity is consistent across sources: TopoQuest and TopoZone both put Lone Star Lookout Tower in Metcalfe County (TopoZone's list shows it on the Edmonton quadrangle). The record's county is blank; it should read Metcalfe, but I did not change the tower record. Elevation agrees: 1079 ft is 329 m, matching the OSM tag. The OSM tags say observation tower, lattice construction, while the latest changeset comment calls it a communication mast, so current use is unclear. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Kentucky lists (checked 2026-10-21). Two searches and about six page reads found no construction date, builder, staffing or fate. Story is about 90 words, below the 120-word floor, because no more is supported. Editor should check current status before any visit wording goes out.
